title: 5.8.4 Debugging: The heavy ball that flies
description: Two planted bugs. The "heavy" ball shoots away and the light one barely moves. The labels are right; the physics is reversed.

steps.title: Run it and press P
steps.instructions: The ball marked heavy moves furthest, which is backwards: more mass means harder to push.

steps.title: Bug 2: only one ball is pushed
steps.instructions: `applyForce` is called on `heavy` twice and never on `light`, so the comparison is not a comparison. Push both with the same force.

requirements.title: Both masses are set
requirements.description: Both balls get a mass, and the heavier one has the larger number. Help: 5.8.1 (Reading: Four knobs: mass, gravityScale, rotationLock, debug)

requirements.title: Both are pushed
requirements.description: The same applyForce reaches both balls. Help: 5.8.1 (Reading: Four knobs)
